title: Shinonome Ena — Matching Bracelets〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Stopped Hand Moves Once More

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A key, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think we're gonna see when we open it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's gotta be connected to a strange, new place! Like a portal to another world!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, where do you get these ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I am looking forward to seeing what's on the other side.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not...right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I think that's for the best.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right, this is your SEKAI, after all.
You should open that door when you feel comfortable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not like you absolutely have to open it right this second. You can think about it more after things have settled down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: For now...I just want to focus on tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So we're done here.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm going too.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I guess we should also head back?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, wait!
I've also got bracelets for you two!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
This one's for you, Kanade! And here's yours, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do your bracelets look like...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Probably the same as Mafuyu's, right?
Can you show us yours for a second?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, look at that. They are the same.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Maybe the decorations are slightly different colors?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I wanted them all to match♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Here's the one I made for myself!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, you made four in total?
When did you have the time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
While I was skipping school, obviously!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Obviously...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: More importantly, Kanade, Ena, try on your bracelets! I wanna make sure the clasps work properly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's see... Like this...? Okay, it's on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How is it? Does the clasp work okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, it seems fine.
And it fits pretty well!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, I could wear this on a regular basis, I bet. The colors aren't all that flashy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right? I designed them so that they go with any outfit! Wear it to your heart's content!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I think I will.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What do you think, Kanade?
Does the clasp on yours work? It's not too big?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Take this part and... Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: One more time... Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. She's really fighting for her life there, isn't she?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
They can be hard to put on if you're not used to wearing one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, maybe give her a hand instead of just standing there watching?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, Kanade, lemme put it on for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, it's on!
And the clasp works just fine.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... Yeah, and it fits just right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It looks nice on you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? It does?
I really didn't think it'd match my sweats...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unlike Kanade, we can't be there when you talk to her, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I thought these would help make it feel like we're there with you in spirit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Like we're there with her in spirit...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mafuyu.
Take good care of that bracelet, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why are you telling me that, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Obviously, because it matters a lot.
Anyway, promise?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I promise...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'll take good care of mine as well.)
